messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up everyone 1  auditors flagged a gap in encryption evidence for a subset of infra and contractor-owned keys. We need a short remediation sweep this week. Please read below and act by Fri 07/05 EOD.

Ava (People Ops): Actions: 1) Contractors and owners of key material: upload key-handling SOP or KMS policy snippet. 2) For infra: upload key-rotation logs or a signed attestation from the owner. 3) Fill the "evidence-quickform" (link) with file links. Use filename pattern: team_controlkey_short_YYYYMMDD.pdf.

Noah (Security): To export rotation logs from GCP KMS use: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys versions list --keyring=prod-kr --key=my-key --location=global --format=json > kms-versions-20240701.json
```
Include a one-paragraph README stating rotation cadence and who can decrypt.

Ivy (Contractor): Im a contractor and I dont have access to the KMS console. What should I upload?

Noah (Security): Ivy  if you touch keys but lack console access, upload the SOP or the signed statement from your manager confirming you do not hold keys and describe how secrets are provisioned for your service. Use the "contractor-evidence" folder.

Kai (Legal): If any uploaded artifact references customer data usage, redact the PII and add a redaction rationale file. Legal will sign off within 48 hours. Tag me @Kai if you need help.

Ava (People Ops): Office hours Thu 11:30-12:30 in #help for filename checks and quick reviews. Well prioritize contractor uploads in the queue.

ComplianceBot: Reminder: 5 infra artifacts flagged missing (encryption/rotation docs). Deadline 07/05 EOD.

Ivy (Contractor): Thanks  Ill upload a manager-signed attestation today and link it in the form.

Noah (Security): Thanks team. Quick checklist: filename matches pattern, README next to exports, redaction rationale if applicable, and add your name to the "evidence-owner" column in the tracker.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: urgent encryption evidence sweep, contractors included, deadline Fri 07/05 EOD. Ping me or @Noah/@Kai with blockers. :lock:
